scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @ventas/api
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @ventas/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w @ventas/api
scripts.dev:create-channel: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:create-channel -w @ventas/api --
scripts.dev:sync-channel-webhook: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:sync-channel-webhook -w @ventas/api --
scripts.dev:send: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:send -w @ventas/api --
scripts.dev:resume-channel: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:resume-channel -w @ventas/api --
